cwe_content.cwe: CWE-1321,Improperly Controlled Modification of Object Prototype Attributes ('Prototype Pollution')

candidate.Reason: The code grants full access to unprotected subobjects of the string, math, and random modules. This is dangerous because it allows unrestricted access to all attributes and methods of these modules, including potentially unsafe ones like the Formatter class in the string module which could be exploited for remote code execution.
